7WU9: Nanak has made the Lord's Name his wealth, by the Grace of the Perfect Guru. ||2||
By the grace of the perfect Guru Nanak has made God's Name his wealth.
NKHD: Deception does not work with our Lord and Master; through their greed and emotional attachment, people are ruined.
Fraud avails not with the spouse. Through avarice and worldly love the mortal is ruined.
ZC35: They do their evil deeds, and sleep in the intoxication of Maya.
The men commit evil deeds and are asleep in the ego of wealth.
WMTX: Time and time again, they are consigned to reincarnation, and abandoned on the path of Death.
Over and over again they are goaded into existences and are abandoned on death's track.
ZF8B: They receive the consequences of their own actions, and are yoked to their pain.
Yoked to pain they obtain the desert of their deeds.
JYRY: O Nanak, if one forgets the Name, all the seasons are evil. ||12||
Nanak evil are all the seasons when one forgets the Lord's Name.
JZGF: While standing up, sitting down and sleeping, be at peace;
One abides in sublime peace while standing sitting and sleeping,
68JJ: O Nanak, praising the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mind and body are cooled and soothed. ||1||
and one's mind and body are cooled by praising the Name. O Nanak!
24RA: Filled with greed, he constantly wanders around; he does not do any good deeds.
The mortal ever wanders about filled with avarice and odes not do any meritorious act.
8PL5: O Nanak, the Lord abides within the mind of one who meets with the Guru. ||2||
Nanak that Lord abides within the mind of him whom the Guru meets.
B4AC: All material things are bitter; the True Name alone is sweet.
Bitter are all other things. The True Lord's Name alone is sweet.
7CT2: Those humble servants of the Lord who taste it, come to savor its flavor.
Those God's men and saints who taste it, realise the relish of it.
E8CV: It comes to dwell within the mind of those who are so pre-destined by the Supreme Lord God.
The Name dwells within the mind of him foe whom the supreme Lord has so destined.
G0PW: The One Immaculate Lord is pervading everywhere; He destroys the love of duality.
He sees the unique Pure Lord pervading everywhere and he destroys another's love.
SFR9: Nanak begs for the Lord's Name, with his palms pressed together; by His Pleasure, God has granted it. ||13||
With folded hands Nanak asks for God's Name, which by His pleasure the Lord has granted to him.
TU5R: The most excellent begging is begging for the One Lord.
That is the best begging, which begs for the One Lord.
PSZG: Other talk is corrupt, O Nanak, except that of the Lord Master. ||1||
Except the Name of the Master all other talks are sinful, O Nanak.
M2ER: One who recognizes the Lord is very rare; his mind is pierced through with the Love of the Lord.
There is hardly any recogniser of God, whose mind is pierces through with His Love.
P811: Such a Saint is the Uniter, O Nanak - he straightens out the path. ||2||
Evenly smooth shall be the path, O Nanak if the saint Guru be the uniter.
8YA1: Serve Him, O my soul, who is the Giver and the Forgiver.
My soul serve you Him who is the Bestower and the Forgiver.
RGEG: All sinful mistakes are erased, by meditating in remembrance on the Lord of the Universe.
All the sins are effaces by remembering the world-sustainer.
FM1A: The Holy Saint has shown me the Way to the Lord; I chant the GurMantra.
The saint has shown me the way to God and so I contemplate over Guru's hymns.
YGQP: The taste of Maya is totally bland and insipid; the Lord alone is pleasing to my mind.
The relishes of the riches are al insipid. God alone is pleasing to my mind.
Z2FC: Meditate, O Nanak, on the Transcendent Lord, who has blessed you with your soul and your life. ||14||
Meditate you, O Nanak on the Supreme Lord, who has blessed you with life.
J6HM: The time has come to plant the seed of the Lord's Name; one who plants it, shall eat its fruit.
The opportune time to sow the True Name has arrived. He who sows it shall eat the fruit.
HURW: He alone receives it, O Nanak, whose destiny is so pre-ordained. ||1||
He, alone obtains (sows) it, in whose lot is so writ, O Nanak.
YFR1: If one begs, then he should beg for the Name of the True One, which is given only by His Pleasure.
If one is to beg then he should beg the One True Name. He alone obtains it, whom the Lord Himself by His pleasure, gives.
NZB9: Eating this gift from the Lord and Master, O Nanak, the mind is satisfied. ||2||
Nanak the Name is the Lord's gift by partaking of which the soul is sated.
THNP: They alone earn profit in this world, who have the wealth of the Lord's Name.
They alone earn profit in the world who have the capital of the wealth of God's Name.
0K0A: They do not know the love of duality; they place their hopes in the True Lord.
They know not another's love and place their hope in only the True Lord.
ZRX6: They serve the One Eternal Lord, and give up everything else.
Stilling all other desires they serve the Eternal Lord alone.
LV01: One who forgets the Supreme Lord God - useless is his breath.
Useless is the breath of him, who forgets the Lofty Lord.
Z6RT: God draws His humble servant close in His loving embrace and protects him - Nanak is a sacrifice to Him. ||15||
Nanak is devoted to Him who hugging to His breast saves His slave.
ZZ59: The Supreme Lord God gave the Order, and the rain automatically began to fall.
The Supreme Lord so willed and the rain began to fall spontaneously.
B13S: Grain and wealth were produced in abundance; the earth was totally satisfied and satiated.
Abundant grain and wealth were produced and the earth was thoroughly sated and satiated.
RZ58: Forever and ever, chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and pain and poverty shall run away.
Ever and ever the saint utters Lord's Praise and his pain and poverty have fled away.
GC3E: People obtain that which they are pre-ordained to receive, according to the Will of the Lord.
The mortal obtains what is preordained for Him. He receives according to His will.
AH1T: The Transcendent Lord keeps you alive; O Nanak, meditate on Him. ||1||
Meditate you on Him the Lord, O Nanak who keeps you alive.

0VKA: To obtain the state of life of Nirvaanaa, meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.
To gain the immortal status remember you the One pure Lord.
2HXY: There is no other place; how else can we be comforted?
There is no other place. How can we be content with another?
KQ04: I have seen the whole world - without the Lord's Name, there is no peace at all.
I have seen the whole world, there is no peace without the Lord's Name.
K0VY: Body and wealth shall return to dust - hardly anyone realizes this.
The body and wealth shall become dust but hardly any one understands this.
CYHQ: Pleasure, beauty and delicious tastes are useless; what are you doing, O mortal?
Pleasure, beauty and relishes are vain. What are you engaged in, O Mortal.
2YZ6: One whom the Lord Himself misleads, does not understand His awesome power.
He whom God Himself deludes understands not His might.
3QY4: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord attain Nirvaanaa, singing the Praises of the True One.
They who are imbued with the love of the Pure Lord sing the True Name.
1QRZ: Nanak: those who are pleasing to Your Will, O Lord, seek Sanctuary at Your Door. ||2||
Nanak whosoever are pleasing to You, O Lord, seek the shelter at Your door.
6WK5: Those who are attached to the hem of the Lord's robe, do not suffer birth and death.
They who are attached to God's skirt suffer not birth and death.
4WHC: Those who remain awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises - their lives are approved.
They who are awake to God's praise are approved in their very life.
498A: Those who attain the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, are very fortunate.
Very fortunate are they who get the society of saints.
Z6D4: But those who forget the Name - their lives are cursed, and broken like thin strands of thread.
Accursed is the life, which forgets the Name. It breaks like the frail thread.
U9RT: O Nanak, the dust of the feet of the Holy is more sacred than hundreds of thousands, even millions of cleansing baths at sacred shrines. ||16||
Nanak the dust of saints feet is more sacred than lacs and millions of ablutions at Paryag.
8BN5: Like the beautiful earth, adorned with jewels of grass - such is the mind, within which the Love of the Lord abides.
The heart in which the love of Lord God abides is like the beauteous earth, studded with the gems of grass.
BJQY: All one's affairs are easily resolved, O Nanak, when the Guru, the True Guru, is pleased. ||1||
Nanak all the affairs become easy, when the great True Guru becomes pleased.
8W8V: Roaming and wandering in the ten directions, over water, mountains and forests
The kite, roams and wanders in ten direction over waters, mountains and forests,
N9F2: - wherever the vulture sees a dead body, he flies down and lands. ||2||
but comes and alights where is sees any carrion.
UEVF: One who longs for all comforts and rewards should practice Truth.
He who desires all comforts and gifts should practise Truth.
2GE8: Behold the Supreme Lord God near you, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
See you the Supreme Lord near and meditate on the Name alone.
0LMZ: Become the dust of all men's feet, and so merge with the Lord.
Be You the dust of the feet of all men and get blended with God.
F96Z: Do not cause any being to suffer, and you shall go to your true home with honor.
Cause not annoyance to any being and go to your Home with honour.
3CGD: Nanak speaks of the Purifier of sinners, the Creator, the Primal Being. ||17||
Nanak tells about the Name of the Lord Creator, the Purifier of the sinners.
T0X6: I have made the One Lord my Friend; He is All-powerful to do everything.
I have made Him the Friend, who is capable of doing everything.
E5LU: My soul is a sacrifice to Him; the Lord is the treasure of my mind and body. ||1||
Onto Him my soul is a sacrifice, God is the wealth of my mind and body.
NZ9X: Take my hand, O my Beloved; I shall never forsake You.
My Beloved, if You catch me by the hand, I shall in no case forsake You.
MXD8: Those who forsake the Lord, are the most evil people; they shall fall into the horrible pit of hell. ||2||
Evil are the persons, who forsake God. They fall into the torments of hell.
ULPZ: All treasures are in His Home; whatever the Lord does, comes to pass.
All the treasure are in his home. Whatever the Lord does that comes to pass.
6E4D: The Saints live by chanting and meditating on the Lord, washing off the filth of their sins.
The holy-men live to contemplate and ponder over the Lord and so wash off their filth of sins.
JQZE: With the Lotus Feet of the Lord dwelling within the heart, all misfortune is taken away.
By abiding Lord's lotus feet in the mind, all the calamities are annulled.
CK3Z: One who meets the Perfect Guru, shall not have to suffer through birth and death.
He who meets the Perfect Guru bewails not in birth and death.
6LSL: Nanak is thirsty for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; by His Grace, He has bestowed it. ||18||
For Lord's sight Nanak has a great thirst. By His grace, He has blessed Nanak with it.
AN4H: If you can dispel your doubts, even for an instant, and love your only Beloved,
If you dispellest your doubt a little and love the only Beloved,
FL86: then wherever you go, there you shall find Him. ||1||
you shall find Him present there, where ever you goest.
CJQ6: Can they mount horses and handle guns, if all they know is the game of polo?
Can persons, knowing only the game of stick and ball (polo) mount horses and handle guns?
F30T: Can they be swans, and fulfill their conscious desires, if they can only fly like chickens? ||2||
Can the fowls which have cock like flight succeed in their hearty wish to be at par with the swans?
BNNU: Those who chant the Lord's Name with their tongues and hear it with their ears are saved, O my friend.
He who utters God's Name with his tongue and hears it with his ears is saves, O my friend.
Z9Q0: Those hands which lovingly write the Praises of the Lord are pure.
The hands which write God's praise with love, are pure.
00QW: It is like performing all sorts of virtuous deeds, and bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Such person obtains the merit of ablutions at sixty eight holies and is deemed to have performed all the virtuous deeds.
MC0X: They cross over the world-ocean, and conquer the fortress of corruption.
He crosses the world -ocean and subjugates the castle of evil.

ZCDN: O Nanak, serve the Infinite Lord; grasp the hem of His robe, and He will save you. ||19||
Nanak, serve you the Infinite Lord, who by attaching you to His skirt shall save you.
0QSV: Worldly affairs are unprofitable, if the One Lord does not come to mind.
Unprofitable are the worldly affairs in which the One Lord comes not in man's min.
YNL8: O Nanak, the bodies of those who forget their Master shall burst apart. ||1||
Nanak, burst out hose bodies who forget the Master.
UD3T: The ghost has been transformed into an angel by the Creator Lord.
He the Creator has transformed the ghost into an angel.
33SY: God has emancipated all the Sikhs and resolved their affairs.
The Lord has emancipated all the disciples of the Guru and arranged their affairs.
YE4Z: He has seized the slanderers and thrown them to the ground, and declared them false in His Court.
Seizing the slanderers, God has hashed them to the ground and has declared them false in His court.
47NE: Nanak's God is glorious and great; He Himself creates and adorns. ||2||
Great is Nanak's Lord. He Himself creates and adorns all.
FV35: God is unlimited; He has no limit; He is the One who does everything.
Infinite is the Lord. He has no limit, It is He who does everything.
4F4F: The Inaccessible and Unapproachable Lord and Master is the Support of His beings.
The Inaccessible and Inarpprehensible Lord is the supporter of the beings.
L81W: Giving His Hand, He nurtures and cherishes; He is the Filler and Fulfiller.
Giving His hand the Lord nourishes all. He is their Filler and Cherisher.
D846: He Himself is Merciful and Forgiving. Chanting the True Name, one is saved.
He Himself is merciful and forgiving. By remembering the True One the mortal is saved.
2QPQ: Whatever pleases You - that alone is good; slave Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||20||
Whatever pleases You, that alone is good. Slave Nanak has sought Yours shelter.
34MV: One who belongs to God has no hunger.
He who has Him as his Lord is left with no hunger.
AYVA: O Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved. ||1||
Nanak, everyone who falls at his feet is saved.
DZY5: If the beggar begs for the Lord's Name every day, his Lord and Master will grant his request.
Nanak if the beggar daily begs for the Name the Lord grants his request.
ZUFN: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord is the most generous host; He does not lack anything at all. ||2||
The Lord is my alms-giver, O Nanak and He has absolutely no want.
K5UL: To imbue the mind with the Lord of the Universe is the true food and dress.
To be imbued with the Lord is man's true viand and wear.
DVP4: To embrace love for the Name of the Lord is to possess horses and elephants.
The embracing of love for God's Name is to possess elephants and horses.
FRZ1: To meditate on the Lord steadfastly is to rule over kingdoms of property and enjoy all sorts of pleasures.
To unswervingly remember God is to possess kingdom, property and abundant amusements.
H50X: The minstrel begs at God's Door - he shall never leave that Door.
The minstrel is to beg the Lord's door which he is never going to leave.
PC8G: Nanak has this yearning in his mind and body - he longs continually for God. ||21||1|| Sudh Keechay||
Within Nanak's mind and body is this eagerness: that he, ever, longs for the Lord.
5GA2: Raag Gauree, The Word Of The Devotees:
Gauri Measure The hymns of the Saints.
W5YG: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. By Guru's Grace:
There is but one God. True is His Name and creative His personality. By the Guru's grace He is obtained.
HM6A: Gauree Gwaarayree, Fourteen Chau-Padhay Of Kabeer Jee:
2T0H: I was on fire, but now I have found the Water of the Lord's Name.
While on fire, I have, now, found the water of the Lord's Name.
URT5: This Water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. ||1||Pause||
The water of the Lord's Name has cooled my burning body. Pause
0G3G: To subdue their minds, some go off into the forests;
To subjugate their mind, men go to forests.
QQ3W: but that Water is not found without the Lord God. ||1||
That water (to quench the fire) is not found without the Fortunate Lord.
8PRS: That fire has consumed angels and mortal beings,
The fire, which has consumed gods and men,
AY2P: but the Water of the Lord's Name saves His humble servants from burning. ||2||
the water of Lord's Name has saved His burning slave from that.
9XGS: In the terrifying world-ocean, there is an ocean of peace.
In the terrible ocean there is an ocean of peace.
2WEZ: I continue to drink it in, but this Water is never exhausted. ||3||
I continue to drink, the water exhausts not.
YHV2: Says Kabeer, meditate and vibrate upon the Lord, like the rainbird remembering the water.
Says Kabir, remember the Lord as does a sparrow-hawk remember the water.
NZEL: The Water of the Lord's Name has quenched my thirst. ||4||1||
Lord's Name is the water which has quenched my thirst.
VY9B: O Lord, my thirst for the Water of Your Name will not go away.
O the Lord of wealth, my thirst for the water of Your Name departs not.
WQ7Q: The fire of my thirst burns even more brightly in that Water. ||1||Pause||
In (for) that water, my ardour is rather raging more. Pause.
LHPV: You are the Ocean of Water, and I am just a fish in that Water.
You are an ocean of water and I a fish of water.
CSCC: In that Water, I remain; without that Water, I would perish. ||1||
I dwell in water and without water I perish.
SR1H: You are the cage, and I am Your parrot.
You are the cage and I am Yours parrot.
JTWC: So what can the cat of death do to me? ||2||
What can the cat of death do to me?
9Y5X: You are the tree, and I am the bird.
You are the tree and I am a bird.
8DCD: I am so unfortunate - I cannot see the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan! ||3||
Unlucky as I am I see you not.

NQXL: You are the True Guru, and I am Your new disciple.
You are the True Guru and I a new disciple of Yours.
34ZA: Says Kabeer, O Lord, please meet me - this is my very last chance! ||4||2||
Says Kabir, meet me, O Lord at the last movement of mine.
611E: When I realize that there is One, and only One Lord,
When I realise that there is but one Lord,
RN4G: why then should the people be upset? ||1||
why then, should people feel distressed at it?
LK82: I am dishonored; I have lost my honor.
I am dishonoured, I have lost my honour.
8UN3: No one should follow in my footsteps. ||1||Pause||
Let no one follow in my foot steps. Pause.
E1MJ: I am bad, and bad in my mind as well.
I am bad, and bad in mind as well.
777W: I have no partnership with anyone. ||2||
I have no partnership with anyone.
BN0H: I have no shame about honor or dishonor.
About honour and dishonour, I feel no shame,
XAWD: But you shall know, when your own false covering is laid bare. ||3||
but you shall know then, when your gilding shall be laid bare.
NB5L: Says Kabeer, honor is that which is accepted by the Lord.
Says Kabir, that is honour, which is acceptable to God.
J0KB: Give up everything - meditate, vibrate upon the Lord alone. ||4||3||
Forsake all else and meditate on the Omnipresent Lord alone.
S3N3: If Yoga could be obtained by wandering around naked,
If union with God be obtained by going about naked,
219H: then all the deer of the forest would be liberated. ||1||
then all the deer of forest would be emancipated.
QTRN: What does it matter whether someone goes naked, or wears a deer skin,
What matters is weather man goes naked or wears a (deer) skin,
65N6: if he does not remember the Lord within his soul? ||1||Pause||
when he remembers not the Pervading Lord in his mind. Pause.
LDLR: If the spiritual perfection of the Siddhas could be obtained by shaving the head,
If perfection be obtained by shaving the head,
QMDU: then why haven't sheep found liberation? ||2||
then for the sheep salvation is not gone anywhere.
GFGE: If someone could save himself by celibacy, O Siblings of Destiny,
O brother, if one be saved by celibacy,
YNCF: why then haven't eunuchs obtained the state of supreme dignity? ||3||
why should not an eunuch obtain the supreme dignity.
4RQ5: Says Kabeer, listen, O men, O Siblings of Destiny:
Says Kabir, hear O men, my brethren,
EWFF: without the Lord's Name, who has ever found salvation? ||4||4||
without the Lord's Name, who has ever obtained salvation?
FSPD: Those who take their ritual baths in the evening and the morning
They who take bath in the evening and the morning,
FHW0: are like the frogs in the water. ||1||
are like frogs in the water.
0B81: When people do not love the Lord's Name,
When men have no love for the Lord's Name,
Y5GQ: they must all go to the Righteous Judge of Dharma. ||1||Pause||
they shall all go to the Righteous Judge, to account for their deeds. Pause.
3B5Q: Those who love their bodies and try different looks,
They who are in love with their bodies, and assume many forms,
1EGK: do not feel compassion, even in dreams. ||2||
feel not compassion even in their dream.
XCQV: The wise men call them four-footed creatures;
So many wise-men say that such persons are the four-footed animals,
VMLE: the Holy find peace in this ocean of pain. ||3||
but the saints obtain peace in this ocean of strife.
DHEM: Says Kabeer, why do you perform so many rituals?
Says Kabir, why should we perform so many ceremonies?
9W2P: Renounce everything, and drink in the supreme essence of the Lord. ||4||5||
Forsake all others and quaff only the supreme Name Nectar.
YU68: What use is chanting, and what use is penance, fasting or devotional worship,
What avails meditation, what penance and what fasting and worship to Him,
BPK6: to one whose heart is filled with the love of duality? ||1||
in whose heart there is the love of another?
D494: O humble people, link your mind to the Lord.
O man, apply your mind to the Lord of wealth.
A10Q: Through cleverness, the four-armed Lord is not obtained. ||Pause||
Through cleverness, the four armed Lord God is not obtained. Pause.
BG6S: Set aside your greed and worldly ways.
HFNF: Set aside sexual desire, anger and egotism. ||2||
Lay aside lust, wrath and pride.
EW0E: Ritual practices bind people in egotism;
With the practise of rituals one is bound down by ego.
C4GH: They join together and worship a stone.
Z5VV: Says Kabeer, He is obtained only by devotional worship.
Says Kabir, by devotion the Lord is obtained.
CU3W: Through innocent love, the Lord is met. ||4||6||
Through simplicity, the king of Raghwas, God is met
RY8P: In the dwelling of the womb, there is no ancestry or social status.
In the womb dwelling, the mortal has no lineage and caste.
Z6TR: All have originated from the Seed of God. ||1||
From the seed of the Lord, all have sprung.
86LZ: Tell me, O Pandit, O religious scholar: since when have you been a Brahmin?
Say O Pandit, since when have you been a Brahman?
JVDW: Don't waste your life by continually claiming to be a Brahmin. ||1||Pause||
Waste not your life by repeatedly calling yourself Brahman. Pause.
2H9W: If you are indeed a Brahmin, born of a Brahmin mother,
If you are a Brahman, born of a Brahman Mother,
5799: then why didn't you come by some other way? ||2||
then, why have you not come by some other way?
0DEP: How is it that you are a Brahmin, and I am of a low social status?
How are you a Brahman, and how am I of low caste?
DP9L: How is it that I am formed of blood, and you are made of milk? ||3||
How am I of blood and how you are of milk?
9W9F: Says Kabeer, one who contemplates God,
Says Kabir, only he who contemplates over the Lord,
8Y1H: is said to be a Brahmin among us. ||4||7||
is said to be a Brahman, among us.

U51Q: In the darkness, no one can sleep in peace.
In spiritual ignorance, one can never sleep in peace.
ADQS: The king and the pauper both weep and cry. ||1||
The king and the pauper both weep alike.
N47T: As long as the tongue does not chant the Lord's Name,
Till the time man's tongue repeats not Lord's Name,
74LV: the person continues coming and going in reincarnation, crying out in pain. ||1||Pause||
he continues coming, going and bemoaning. Pause.
QPYC: It is like the shadow of a tree;
The wealth, which appears to be like the shadow of a tree,
C6BM: when the breath of life passes out of the mortal being, tell me, what becomes of his wealth? ||2||
tell! who shall it belong when the life departs?
B7BR: It is like the music contained in the instrument;
As is the tune contained in the instrument so is the life in the body,
3E04: how can anyone know the secret of the dead? ||3||
therefore how can anyone know the secret of the dead.
F9GX: Like the swan on the lake, death hovers over the body.
As the swan moves about the lake, so does death hover over man's body.
W1H4: Drink in the Lord's sweet elixir, Kabeer. ||4||8||
Lord's elixir, quaff you, O Kabir.
ACF4: The creation is born of the Light, and the Light is in the creation.
Of the luminous Lord is the creation. Because of mind's intent the world fruitions.
GWL9: It bears two fruits: the false glass and the true pearl. ||1||
That mind's bear fruits like the true pearl and the false glass.
SAMT: Where is that home, which is said to be free of fear?
Which is that house that is said to be without fear?
PNH6: There, fear is dispelled and one lives without fear. ||1||Pause||
Where fear is dispelled and one abides fearlessly. Pause.
GLKG: On the banks of sacred rivers, the mind is not appeased.
At the banks of sacred waters the soul is not propitiated.
D1ML: People remain entangled in good and bad deeds. ||2||
In meritorious deeds and evil acts, the mortals remain entangled.
GUJU: Sin and virtue are both the same.
The demerits and merits are both the same.
RNMN: In the home of your own being, is the Philosopher's Stone; renounce your search for any other virtue. ||3||
In your own home is God, the Transmuting stone. Shed seeking virtues form any other.
0TZD: Kabeer: O worthless mortal, do not lose the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Kabir O virtueless man fall not out with the Lord's Name.
3RY7: Keep this mind of yours involved in this involvement. ||4||9||
Keep this mind of yours recreated in this recreation.
Z03W: He claims to know the Lord, who is beyond measure and beyond thought;
The man who knows not the Inestimable and Incomprehensible Lord,
Y42F: by mere words, he plans to enter heaven. ||1||
wishes to enter heaven by mere words.
GBPM: I do not know where heaven is.
I know not where Lord's abode is.
YYUZ: Everyone claims that he plans to go there. ||1||Pause||
Everyone says he wishes to go and reach there. Pause.
NT1W: By mere talk, the mind is not appeased.
By mere talk man's mind is sated not then alone,
7TYF: The mind is only appeased, when egotism is conquered. ||2||
the mind is appeased, when pride is stilled.
MZHK: As long as the mind is filled with the desire for heaven,
As long as there is desire for paradise in man's mind,
QFNT: he does not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||3||
so long he abides not at the Lord's feet.
0JW8: Says Kabeer, to whom should I tell this?
